summary_en: This focused review synthesizes photoacoustic imaging approaches for objective, non-invasive burn-depth assessment. It covers the modality's physical basis, system configurations, evidence from animal and emerging clinical studies, comparative advantages over conventional assessment methods, and the main engineering and translational barriers that remain before routine clinical use.
